metadata.title: Non-profit | TruMinds Clinical
metadata.description: Explore the people, partnerships and access guiding TruMinds Clinical’s non-profit focus and commitment to improving lives beyond clinical research.

hero.title: A wider view
hero.description: Better health depends on more than innovation alone. It also depends on people having the support, knowledge and opportunity to benefit from progress.
hero.imageAlt: Volunteers organizing food and supplies at a community table
hero.caption: Care, connection and opportunity.

overview.title: Purpose belongs
overview.description: Our non-profit focus gives the values behind our work a place to grow. People, partnership and access shape the way we think about progress beyond clinical research.

values.title: People
values.text: Keep the needs and experiences of people at the center of every effort.

values.title: Partnership
values.text: Work with others whose expertise and perspective can make an effort stronger.

values.title: Access
values.text: Look for practical ways to broaden opportunity and understanding.

priorities.title: Care and dignity.
priorities.description: Explore the charitable priorities within our wider Giving Back commitment, from food and safe housing to education, independence and compassionate care.

cta.title: A shared purpose starts with a conversation.
cta.description: Tell us about your organization, the causes that matter to you and the community needs you would like to discuss.
cta.label: Start a conversation
